bio: I am an engineering graduate student at the ATLAS Institute at CU Boulder, finishing the M.S. in May 2027. Before this I took a B.A. in Computer Science at Rollins College, and I have run Sutton Web Solutions, my own software practice, since 2023.

Most of what I build now is agentic. I give an LLM the right context and a way to check its own work, then point it at something real: a factory service manual, a physics textbook, a job listing. Alongside that I am building a demand forecasting model for a bakery. It is gradient boosted trees, a walk-forward backtest and a test that fails if a feature uses future data.

I also build physical things, which is why half of these projects have a robot, a truck or a turntable attached. I play chess, and that is why this is the internship I am applying for. I am in Boulder, Colorado, and I can work anywhere in the USA.
